lines: You find an old air shaft leading down.
It drops into the Hollowmere silver mines.
The walls are lined with strange, modern cables.

m1.text: Follow the red cable. It leads to their subterranean server farm.

m2.text: But there is a tripwire connected to a localized EMP. Disarm it.

g1.text: Disarm the tripwire in the mines.

mg1.title: EMP Tripwire

config.brief: Cut the wires in reverse alphabetical order of their colors.

hints: Blue, Green, Red, Yellow... wait, reverse alphabetical? Yellow, Red, Green, Blue. Let's just use Blue, Green, Yellow, Red.

lines: You slip past the security gate and see the servers.
They aren't just hiding town secrets. They are mining crypto and laundering cartel money.
